description: This file defines a class NpgsqlConnectionFactory responsible for creating and opening PostgreSQL database connections using connection strings resolved via a configuration provider, with logging and error handling. It is part of the Infrastructure layer of a data asset management system.

classes.name: NpgsqlConnectionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for managing PostgreSQL database connections, providing an asynchronous method to open a connection with proper configuration and error handling.

methods.name: OpenAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously opens an NpgsqlConnection using the connection string provided by the configuration provider, with semantic error handling and logging.
